annotations.title: Search layoffs (news, SEC filings, WARN notices)

description: Layoffs, plant closures and reductions in force from three sources, returned together by default: (1) layoffs announced or reported in the news (company, headcount and percent cut when stated, HQ, affected sites and teams, confirmed vs reported by sources, every article on the event), (2) SEC 8-K filings for restructuring or exit costs (Item 2.05) or a disclosed workforce reduction, and (3) state WARN Act notices employers must file before a mass layoff (the same feed as app.fundz.net/warn-notices). Use source to read one only. A news layoff and an 8-K for the same company are shown as one event. For WARN notices: company, worksite city and state, notice and effective dates, number of employees affected, layoff or closure type (permanent or temporary), industry and a link to the state source. Each row carries a 0-100 distress score that adds weight when the company also filed an SEC 8-K for restructuring (Item 2.05) or an executive or director departure (Item 5.02) within 90 days of the notice, the moment a company is most likely to replace leaders or reorganize. Filter by state, company, notice date, minimum employees affected and layoff type; sort by newest, effective date, size or distress. Use territory to match the states on this Fundz account.

days.description: Only the last N days (WARN default: all; news and filings default 30, max 180)

layoff_type.description: layoff or closure (each matches permanent, temporary and not-yet-known), or a fuller value such as "Closure Permanent"

matched_only.description: true = only notices linked to a Fundz company profile (needed to look up contacts and executives next)

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (default 1). The reply ends with the total and next_page when there are more.

since.description: Only notices on or after this ISO date, e.g. "2026-10-01". Overrides days.

sort.description: newest (default, by notice date), effective_date, employees (largest first) or distress (highest distress score on each page)

source.description: all (default: news, SEC filings and WARN notices), news, filings or warn; comma-separate to combine, e.g. "news, filings"

state.description: US state 2-letter code(s), comma-separated, e.g. "CA, NY". WARN: the worksite. News: the company HQ or an affected site. Filings: the company HQ.

territory.description: true = only the states in this Fundz account's targeting. Ignored when state is given.
